incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate detected in /v1/generate across region-us-east-1 starting ~10m ago. Error spike correlated with increased gateway timeouts. Auto-escalation: paging rohan (on-call).
rohan: got the page, looking now. anyone see recent deploys?
sam: no user-facing deploys in the last hour. infra autoscaler did a small bump at +2 nodes 12m ago.
jamie: I'm seeing a big uptick in kv_prefix cache evictions on runtime-serve pool: eviction-rate ~420/s, miss-rate spiking. logs show repeated ``KV_PREFIX::STORAGE_CORRUPT`` on some shards.
nina: customer impact? are requests failing or just slower?
leo: multiple callers reporting 502/504s. Support dashboard shows 18 customers with >5% error rate for the last 15m.
rohan: ok prioritize: 1) validate cache health, 2) fallback routing to model-compat variant, 3) reduce customer impact (rate-limit heavy routes).
jamie: pulling runtime logs. snippet:```
[2026-03-14T14:21:03.512Z] runtime-serve-12 kv_cache eviction shard=12 key_prefix="user:abc" reason=oom entries_evicted=1024
[2026-03-14T14:21:03.513Z] runtime-serve-12 kv_cache error shard=12 err=KV_PREFIX::STORAGE_CORRUPT key=user:abc:chat:prefix
[2026-03-14T14:21:03.514Z] gateway-1 route=/v1/generate status=502 upstream_err=kvcache_miss_timeout
```
sam: can we confirm kv backend (redis/rocks) health? jamie which backend is that pool using?
jamie: it's the local shards using rocksdb-backed PKV. Storage metrics show IO stalls starting same window. iostat shows high iowait on host h12.
rohan: oncall checklist: temporarily disable prefix caching for high-risk routes and roll routing fallback. jamie, can you push a config patch to disable prefix cache on /v1/generate for region-us-east-1? include a quick rollback.
jamie: patch ready, will apply to edge-config:```
PATCH /config/edge HTTP/1.1
Host: config-api.internal
Content-Type: application/json

{ "route": "/v1/generate", "region": "us-east-1", "kv_prefix_cache": "disabled", "reason": "eviction_storm_corruption" }
```
deploy-bot: starting config rollout to region-us-east-1 (canary 10% -> 100%)
rohan: canary and watch metrics. sam, if latency improves but errors persist, we should route to model-compat fallback (cpu-friendly variant) to keep traffic alive.
sam: starting fallback routing change for heavy customers: add policy to route to model-x-small when error_rate > 3% for 1m.
nina: notifying top affected customers with template: "We are investigating elevated errors in US-East - temporarily routing requests to a compatible model to reduce errors. No data loss expected." posting in support now.
leo: support ping: customers asking about request id leakage — reassure them it's transient and we're not dropping payloads.
jamie: after disabling prefix cache canary, immediate drop in eviction-rate on canary hosts. logs now:```
[2026-03-14T14:29:10.001Z] runtime-serve-2 kv_cache eviction shard=2 entries_evicted=8
[2026-03-14T14:29:10.005Z] gateway-1 route=/v1/generate status=200 downstream_latency=112
```
rohan: good sign. escalate to full rollout. deploy-bot proceed.
deploy-bot: rollout at 100% in region-us-east-1 complete. monitoring for 10m.
jamie: noticed a pattern: corruption tied to a compaction race during heavy eviction windows on shards with >1M prefixes. proposing a throttle to eviction task and an immediate janky mitigation: tombstone bad shards and rebuild their prefix index.
sam: tombstone process sounds risky. do we have a non-disruptive rebuild path?
jamie: we can mark shard read-only and spin a new shard-allocated worker to rebuild from S3 checkpoint. takes ~6-8m per shard.
rohan: prioritize rebuild for shards showing STORAGE_CORRUPT. create ticket and runbook steps. Jamie, coordinate with eng-infra for node IO throttling.
jamie: created infra ticket INF-5423 and started rebuild for shard 12. commands:```
# mark shard read-only
curl -XPOST http://admin.internal/shards/12?action=readonly -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
# spawn rebuild worker
kubectl -n runtime apply -f rebuild-shard-12.yaml
```
sam: meanwhile, we're seeing gateway 5xx drop from 12% -> 2% after cache-disable + fallback routing. still some timeouts for long-running chats (KV misses).
nina: draft incident notice to customers: short, technical summary + ETA for full remediation (~2-4h). I'll circulate.
leo: support queue trending down. updating affected customers that we're in mitigation and will follow up with RCA.
rohan: planning handoff in 45m to night oncall. jamie, please leave clear next steps in the incident ticket.
jamie: added notes: rebuild progress, candidate mitigation (eviction-throttle PR: repo runtime-utils, branch fix/eviction-throttle), and rollback plan (re-enable kv_prefix_cache). PR link: https://git.internal/runtime-utils/pull/789
sam: will monitor for regressions; suggest adding a short-term alert: kv_prefix.corruption_count > 0 -> paging.
rohan: agree. set alert and silence noisy eviction-rate alerts until rebuild finishes.
rohan: summary for handoff: incident started due to eviction storm -> IO stalls -> KV_PREFIX storage corruption on shards -> elevated gateway 5xx and timeouts. Mitigations applied: disabled prefix cache for /v1/generate, fallback routing to model-compat variants, tombstone+rebuild of corrupted shards, IO throttling ticket opened, short-term alert changes. Customer impact: ~18 customers with transient 5xx, majority restored post-mitigation; full RCA - follow-up.
nina: I'll post the customer-facing update in ~15m after we confirm stability window.
leo: leaving running notes in support thread. thanks all. :clap: 
rohan: handing off to night oncall @katie in 45m, will join if anything spikes.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: status=mitigating, severity=high, assignees=[rohan, jamie], started=1780009999, update_ts=1780014800
